note: Moves StorageError, its Clone/From impls and StorageResult out of persons.rs into a new storage_error.rs module and updates the replica import.
Keeps the handwritten LLMPrompt interfaces but types the new label fields via indexed access on generated LLMPromptListApi/VersionSummaryApi/ResolveResponseApi types.
Replaces the "FeatureFlag" string literals in the permission check, queryset exclude and edit guard with ScheduledChange.AllowedModels.FEATURE_FLAG.
Breadcrumbs selector now depends on isNewEvaluation (props-based) and a new evaluationBackTarget selector instead of checking evaluation?.id.
Removes the badge prop and inline organizationBadge from TemplateItem; TemplateItemTitleDescription renders a new OrganizationScopeBadge from template.scope.
Drops the staticDropEventTokens scope component; drop tokens are derived from DROP_EVENTS_BY_TOKEN_DISTINCT_ID config in the consumer.
prepare_for_cloud_handoff sets a dedicated handoff_resumed state flag instead of overloading resume_from_run_id; workflow and provisioning read it.
Makes _effective_filters_after_update null-safe with an optional team arg and calls it from the save gate instead of the duplicated precedence logic.
Moves inbox interactivity helpers and handlers from api.py into a new services/inbox_interactivity.py module and calls them from there.
Renames lanes/ to pipelines/ with single-word names, moving ingestionwarnings to clientwarnings including the e2e test path.
Moves the DEFAULT producer config map into ingestion/common/producers.ts; analytics and error-tracking modules re-export from it.
Adds a rust-compute-affected composite action taking event name and base SHAs; rust-docker-build.yml and ci-rust.yml both use it instead of inline scripts.
Only adds nosemgrep suppression comments to hogbox-preview files; no hogli command is introduced.
Replaces the spread-able storage object with buildAiObservabilityStorageConfig(storageKey) and updates call sites to use it.
Hoists inline tracker classes and helpers to module level, but ExternalDataJob creation is still done inline rather than shared with the job-model activity.
Replaces the inline alert-kind union and ternary in EditAlertModal with insightAlertKindForQuery exported from alertFormLogic.
Renames the chart accessor helpers from xAxisTitle/yAxisTitle to xAxisLabel/yAxisLabel in docs, accessor and tests.
Deletes the standalone fan-out skill and folds its guidance into the pipeline doctor skill and its composition/result/step doctor agents.
Only drops first_name from the dev-login user query and adjusts whitespace; still gated on settings.DEBUG with no new setting.
Removes the Celery investigation trigger and safety-net task from checks.py and ports them to Temporal alerts activities, workflows and schedule.
